The problem

Great work.
Quiet brand.

Most founders and experts lose opportunities they never knew existed. It almost always comes down to three things.

01

Unclear message.

If people can't explain what you do in one sentence, they can't refer you, book you or buy from you. We give you a message so clear your audience repeats it for you.

02

Your feed speaks first.

Prospects check your social media before they take the call, and they decide fast. We build a presence that earns their trust before you say a word.

03

No path to buy.

People are watching, but there's no clear way to start a relationship with you. We build the path that moves them from follower to client to advocate.

You've done the hard part by becoming great at what you do. The rest is what we do best.

How it works

Three deliberate steps.

A clear process, so you always know what comes next.

  1. Apply

    We choose our clients with intention. A brand like this is built over months in close partnership, and it only works when both sides are fully committed. Your application tells us where you are, where you want to go and whether we're the right team to take you there.

    Today

  2. Discovery & strategy

    If it's a fit, we invite you to a short discovery call to understand your goals, your business and your audience. Then we come back with a strategy call where we show you exactly how we'd build and monetize your brand, before you commit to anything.

    By invitation

  3. Build & launch

    Once you're in, all three founders go to work. Your message is sharpened, your image is directed and shot, your content and systems are built and your offers are mapped. Then we launch it together.

    Once you're in
Take step one →
By application

Read this before you apply.

We work closely with every client, so fit matters. Be honest with yourself as you read.

This is for you if

  • You're an established founder, expert or creator with real results behind you
  • You know you're better than your online presence shows
  • You want your brand to bring in clients, speaking invitations and partnerships
  • You see your personal brand as a long-term business asset and are ready to invest in it
  • You'll show up for the shoot, the content and the calls
  • You're open to direction, even when it pushes you past your comfort zone
  • You want to serve your audience at a higher level through products, services and education
  • You value relationships over transactions

This isn't for you if

  • You're looking for a quick hack or overnight virality
  • You want more followers with no plan for what they lead to
  • You aren't willing to be on camera or in front of people
  • You want to hand everything off and stay out of the process
  • You're shopping for the lowest price
  • You see your audience as a list to sell to
  • You can't commit real time over the next few months
  • You're comfortable with things exactly as they are

FAQ

Questions.

What happens after I apply?

Our team reviews every application personally. If it's a fit, we invite you to a short discovery call, followed by a strategy call where we show you how we'd build and monetize your brand. Once you decide to move forward, we start the work.

Who will I work with?

All three founders. Niko, Irma and Christian are on every client, from the first call to launch.

Do I need a large following or my offer figured out?

No. You need a real business and the will to be seen. Your audience and your offers are part of what we build together.

What do I walk away with?

A clear position, an editorial library, a rebuilt profile, weekly content and a system that sells. Scope is set on your strategy call.

How much of my time does it take?

One shoot day, a few sessions up front, then one recording a week. We handle the rest.

What does it cost?

It depends on scope. We share pricing on your strategy call.
